_comment: App-only texts (namespace `app`): only what the web has no key for (biometric unlock, app update, the Kalks Trader placeholder). Everything else uses the web's own keys from packages/i18n. Merged into assets/i18n/<locale>.json by tool/export_i18n.mjs. {placeholders} are filled in by the app.
